title: Client message
description: A message from the browser to a backend: one JSON text frame over the WebSocket. A backend must treat these as untrusted input and enforce the limits below. Lengths are counted in characters here; implementations may count UTF-16 units or bytes, so a backend should leave itself margin rather than rely on the exact boundary for non-ASCII text.

input.description: Keystrokes or a paste, to be written to the program's input as is.

resize.description: The terminal's size in cells. A terminal larger than 1000 cells either way is a mistake or an attack, not a screen.

run.description: Runs one of the commands the backend offered (a `commands` message). It becomes a process command line, so it is bounded and free of NUL; pass it to the program as an argument list, never through a shell, and refuse a command that was not offered.
